title: NFT Nexus
description: This project was intended to rework the truffle pet-shop box into a digital pet adoption game using Decentraland. Unfortunately, there were some issues outside of our control and we could not finish. However, I look forward to continuing the project and sharing it with the NFT community once it is complete.
how_its_made:
This project uses a Truffle Box, Ganache Blockchain and Metamask. I was not able to add the decentraland portion and will do so at a later time. If anyone has any feedback on the decentraland/truffle combination can you please reach out with some insight. 



This project was intended to rework the truffle pet-shop box into a digital pet adoption game using Decentraland. Unfortunately, there were some issues outside of our control and we could not finish. However, I look forward to continuing the project and sharing it with the NFT community once it is complete.
